Name: A Younger Pam
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
I always thought if Pam was a bit younger, she'd exude 80's hairspray energy, and now my visions of big hair and hoop earrings are brought to life. This includes  beach portraits and the 1.6 winter outfits!

Consider using this mod with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9484]Younger Pam Sprites[/url]﻿ made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/125559918]catboyteeth[/url] -- they did some amazing work!
